card.name: Today and every day wording
card.fires_on: The word day, or Today, in phrases about the current or recurring day, such as 'this day', 'every day', 'each day' and sentence-opening 'Today'. It also fires on the punctuation right after Today.

modes.label: Day after this/every/each
modes.description: The word day right after this, every or each, in phrases about a recurring or present day.
modes.example: Learn something new every<< day>> More Info... by email A lock

modes.label: Today as an opener
modes.description: The word Today, or the comma or 's right after it, at the start of a sentence or heading.
modes.example: Today<<,>> new homes are twice as energy-efficient as

card.writes: It pushes the model toward time-of-day and daily words such as /day, morning, daily, yesterday and afternoon.
card.plain: It lights up on words about the current day, like 'today' or 'every day', and predicts more day-time words next.
